The move comes as the company continues to operate under heightened regulatory and investor scrutiny due to the ongoing halt in trading.

data.title: Fibocom Plans Dual 2026 Share Incentive Schemes for A- and H-Shareholders
data.description:
Fibocom Wireless, Inc. Class H ( (HK:0638) ) has issued an announcement.

Fibocom Wireless Inc. has proposed the adoption of a 2026 A-share Restricted Share Incentive Plan and a 2026 H-share Share Award Plan, aiming to align management and employee interests with long-term corporate performance. Both plans require approval at a general meeting under the company’s Articles of Association, despite not needing shareholder approval under Hong Kong Listing Rules.

The A-share plan will use treasury shares, while the H-share plan will rely on existing shares, and participation by certain directors will constitute exempt connected transactions under Chapter 14A. Fibocom will convene an extraordinary general meeting to seek shareholder endorsement and will dispatch a circular detailing both plans, underscoring a continued emphasis on equity-based incentives within regulatory constraints in the PRC and Hong Kong.
